newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon gets $220 million Patriot pacts.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon gets $220 million Patriot pacts.

text.p: Raytheon Co. said Monday it received five contracts totalling more than $220 million for the Patriot Air Defence system.
The bulk of the contracts are with the U.S. Army Missile Command to upgrade the Patriot missile system, except for a $22.9 million award for radar enhancement kits for the Netherlands, it said.

Raytheon said the U.S. Army Missile Command awarded Raytheon: $82.7 million for fiscal year 1997 engineering services; $60.5 million modification to improve the radar system; $35.5 million contract to upgrade the system's ability to identify the targets; and a $19 million contract for remote launching system improvements.
The company's stock was up 62.5 cents at $47.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
